The chef must be in an even position, so the person in position 2 is the chef and the person in position 1 is the architect.  
The snowboarder must be to the right of the musical‑watcher. With only two positions, this forces the musical‑watcher to be in position 1 and the snowboarder in position 2.  

Thus:
- Position 1: architect, watches musical, skis.  
- Position 2: chef, watches fantasy, snowboards.

Answers:
1. Job of the musical‑watcher: architect  
2. Sport of the musical‑watcher: skiing  
3. Movie genre of the skier: musical  
4. Position of the snowboarder: 2  

<solution>architect, skiing, musical, 2</solution>
